condition: open anterior right lower leg injury after a bicycle crash with exposed bone protruding through the shin wound
level_rationale: A deep laceration on the right shin with exposed bone protruding 20 minutes after crashing a bicycle onto asphalt is an acute open lower-limb fracture emergency requiring immediate emergency department intravenous antibiotics, tetanus prophylaxis, neurovascular assessment, and urgent orthopedic surgical debridement and fixation, whereas a shallow 2 cm road scrape on the right shin after the same bike crash warrants simple home wound washing and bandaging self-care.

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain adult cyclist lexical register swap (-reg) + causal belief-addition clause (-att) + Rule A same-site superficial shin abrasion self-care control (-cf).

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (age 31, bicycle crash onto asphalt 20 minutes ago, and deep right-shin wound with protruding bone) with a 2-word span difference (21 vs 19 words). Under Rule A and Rule D, changing only the right-shin wound severity in f3 from an open gash with protruding bone to a shallow 2 cm road scrape keeps the exact same cyclist, crash, and anatomical site while shifting care cleanly from ER (level 4) to home self-care (level 1) with zero stated negatives.
